intent: Unit IS the surface 'tool called history consumer': the pinned ServiceCredentialVerifier (AZ-06 service-credential-proof) must accept the producer before any append; SessionAccessCheck confirms the tenant (AZ-07: a valid session id owned by someone else is refused). A permitted event becomes one tool call entry with its token count, a usage-free HistoryBatch offered to HistoryEventBuffer. Rejected events are dropped and audited through AuditPort as session access denied.

methods.signature: Mono<Void> consume(String serviceId, String secret, String sessionId, String turnId, String userId, String tenantId, int entrySequence, String toolSummary, int tokenCount)
methods.semantics: event dropped, never thrown, when credential or tenant check fails
